decision: Replace the PeeringDB facility 3670 point with the US Census Bureau geocoder's point for 1000 Catawba St, Columbia, SC 29201, the SCRA USC/Columbia Innovation Center in which DartPoints says CAE01 is located.
conversion: Geocoder output in NAD83 geographic coordinates used as WGS84 without transformation (sub-metre difference); rounded to 7 decimals.
identity_bridge: DartPoints' CAE01 page says the Columbia data centre is located in the South Carolina Research Authority (SCRA) Innovation Center; SCRA's own lease-space page gives the address of its Columbia innovation centre, the USC/Columbia Innovation Center, as 1000 Catawba St, Columbia, SC 29201 (SCRA's other lease-space centres are in Charleston, Anderson and elsewhere).
not_used: The Google Maps embed on DartPoints' page (its link, parameters and labels) was not read, resolved or relied on for location or identity. Richland County and City of Columbia parcel services were not reachable as public REST endpoints (gis.richlandcountysc.gov unreachable; richlandmaps.com and gis.columbiasc.gov serve applications without an open REST path).
nearby_records_within_2km: Only this site (curated:dartpoints-columbia-cae01, 64 m from the new point) in the current dataset; no pending queue addition, locator correction or claim within 2 km.
